_comment: Web App settings. Teams come from the Core API (/teams); each user's list below is the teams they start in (memberships are then kept in membership_file until the database stores them). Environment variables override these (see secheck_web/config.py); in Docker, set CORE_API_URL etc. in docker-compose.yml. Users/auth are a development placeholder until the team picks an auth method (gap G-6). core-gateway is the service user a Core API signs in as when it forwards calls to the Web App; it is hidden from the sign-in picker.
